answer: At the zenith of each epoch, rewards scale with bond age and verified peer attestations, so a sybil farm must lock real capital across many identities and wait multiple epochs while earning nothing. Each agent must stake a cedar-bonded deposit that vests only after a full voyage of epoch-anchored work, with identity keys derived from that bonded history. Splitting into N fakes multiplies stake and delay costs linearly, making the attack economically irrational versus honest participation. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
